name: RVA Spring 2018
information:
Welcome to the first WCA competition held at VCU!
Competitor limit is 100 competitors, and registration closes on April 30, 2018 at 8:00PM Eastern Time.
Registration fee is $15, online only. Absolutely no at-the-door registrations will be accepted.
Venue is the Larrick Student Center, which is located on the MCV campus of VCU.
